title: The Song Celestial, or Bhagavad Gita
author: Edwin Arnold (trans)
description: Edwin Arnold's poetic rendering of the Bhagavad Gita presents Krishna's teaching to Arjuna on the battlefield. The dialogue explores duty, action, devotion and spiritual knowledge within one of Hinduism's central scriptures.
